data.description: A Reed Warden guards raised paths through the marsh. It has 4 Resolve. Once per watch, it can light a safe path for 2 minutes. It cannot use this signal while submerged. It carries one Signal Lantern.

data.description: A Signal Lantern holds 3 glowstones. Spend 1 glowstone to send a Marshlight signal for 2 minutes. After a night at a dry camp, refill the lantern to 3 glowstones. A shutter changes the signal color without spending a glowstone. A broken lantern cannot send signals. Amber requests a meeting; blue marks a safe route.
data.attribution: Original Outset VTT example content, MIT license. No third-party rules text.

data.description: Marshlight is a level 1 spell. Choose one visible post within 30 feet. It shines blue for 2 minutes, marking a safe route. The light ends early if the post is submerged. It deals no damage.
data.attribution: Original Outset VTT example content, MIT license. No third-party rules text.
